_root_bio: Originally from Shanghai, I am a first-year Master of Science in Computational Design student at Carnegie Mellon University, building on my Bachelor of Architecture degree from Rice University (Class of 2024). My work focuses on the intersection of mixed reality, computational design, and the integration of generative AI into architectural processes. I've gained practical experience across both China and the U.S.—including roles at EID Architect, Pure Architect, ECAID in Shanghai, and NBBJ in Los Angeles. Currently, I live in Pittsburgh with my lovely wife and our two cats, exploring new frontiers in design and technology.
